title: Warehouse transfers
newSubtitle: Stock only moves after a Manager approves the request.
requested: Transfer {{no}} sent to a Manager for approval.
confirmApprove: Approve {{no}}? The stock will move immediately.

form.searchItems: Search items in the source warehouse
form.needsReceiptHint: The salesperson must confirm receipt after the Manager approves.
form.noItems: Add at least one item to the list.

problem.RECEIVED_SHORT: The receiver reported that less arrived than was sent. The missing quantity went back to the sending warehouse. The Manager follows this up.
problem.NOT_RECEIVED: The receiver reported that nothing arrived. All the stock went back to the sending warehouse. The Manager follows this up.

confirmReceive: Confirm that you received all items of {{no}}? The stock will be added to your warehouse.

receive.title: Did the goods arrive?
receive.hint: Enter what you really received. If something is missing, say what went wrong: the Manager is told and sorts it out. Anything not received goes back to the sending warehouse.
receive.notePlaceholder: Required when something is missing, e.g. 2 cartons missing from the delivery
receive.noteRequired: Say what is missing or what went wrong
receive.badQty: Enter a quantity for every line, not more than was sent.
receive.nothingShort: Every line is complete: use "Received all" instead.

confirm.FULL: Confirm you received everything on {{no}}? The stock enters your warehouse.
confirm.SHORT: Confirm {{no}} was received SHORT? Only the quantities you entered enter your warehouse; the rest goes back to the sending warehouse and the Manager is told.
confirm.NONE: Confirm NOTHING of {{no}} was received? All of it goes back to the sending warehouse and the Manager is told.
